name: 落水挣扎
description: 角色在水中挣扎：只露头与双臂在水面，水花四溅，惊慌表情

generation.promptTemplate: {characterAnchor}, drowning struggle pose: only head and two arms visible above water surface inside the container, splashing water around, panicked expression, mouth open calling for help, wet hair and wet clothes clinging
generation.negativeExtra: standing dry, calm expression, full body on land, no water, smiling

placement.note: 落水者叠放在容器（缸）的水面位置；缸内需有水——若缸是空缸变体，须换'盛水缸'状态变体

acceptance: 落水者只露头与手臂在水面（非全身站立）
水花/湿发/惊慌表情存在
落水者位置在缸口范围内
